hero.titulo:
Internet isn't a luxury.
It's a right.
hero.descripcion: Deep in the hills of Córdoba, we work to bring connectivity where telecom companies don't go. We design and deploy telecommunications infrastructure adapted to rural and hard-to-reach environments.

lagunita.mision: We believe distance shouldn't be a barrier to education, work, or communication. That's why we participate in connectivity initiatives for those who need it most.

proyecto.descripcion: We work on the design, deployment, and maintenance of telecommunications infrastructure for rural and hard-to-reach environments. Our team carries out technical surveys, structure installation, wireless link configuration, and commissioning of connectivity solutions tailored to each need.
proyecto.trabajo: We climb hills, install towers, and configure wireless links in areas where no commercial provider operates. We work collaboratively and with commitment, contributing technical expertise at every stage of the project.

educacion.descripcion: One of the project's priorities is ensuring access to educational platforms, digital materials, and communication tools for teachers and students in rural areas.
educacion.capacitaciones: We also organize open workshops on Meshtastic and community networking — because the best infrastructure is the kind the community itself can maintain and grow.

innovacion.descripcion: As part of the project, we're integrating LoRaWAN technology — long-range, ultra-low-power communication — to build reliable links even where line-of-sight between the hills is a challenge.
innovacion.futuro: This phase enables environmental monitoring, distributed sensors, and a community network with autonomous growth capacity. A homegrown tech ecosystem, built from the inside out.

galeria.subtitulo: Towers, cables, hills, and people. This is what community infrastructure looks like.

footer.descripcion: A community connectivity initiative in the hills of Córdoba, Argentina. CicloIT CCC contributes technical expertise in infrastructure design, installation, and maintenance.
